items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: His wife, Blue Lu Barker, is cited by Billie Holiday as being one of her major early influences

ctx.x: That’s what I’m trying to get at.

And Danny Barker could read chord changes, but he was a very natural musician. But that’s another example of what I was talking about earlier as far as New Orleans musicians affecting — their culture affecting — like for instance Danny Barker moved to New York, played with Charlie Parker, played with Cab Calloway, he played behind Billie Holiday. His wife, Blue Lu Barker, is cited by Billie Holiday as being one of her major early influences as far as how she approached — and you know Blue Lu Barker came out, she…
That sounds great. You mentioned sort of an aside, like well I’m not a great stride player and here I am playing with Evan Christopher.
